title: dryopteris deparioides subsp. gracillima
intro: Dryopteris deparioides subsp. gracillima, commonly known as a fern species, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris deparioides subsp. gracillima include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cytotoxic effects on certain pathogens. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids have been identified in this plant, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
